\texttt{L\allowbreak{}e\allowbreak{}a\allowbreak{}n\allowbreak{}e\allowbreak{}r\allowbreak{}V\allowbreak{}M\allowbreak{}/\allowbreak{}P\allowbreak{}r\allowbreak{}o\allowbreak{}t\allowbreak{}o\allowbreak{}c\allowbreak{}o\allowbreak{}l\allowbreak{}/\allowbreak{}P\allowbreak{}u\allowbreak{}b\allowbreak{}l\allowbreak{}i\allowbreak{}c\allowbreak{}I\allowbreak{}n\allowbreak{}p\allowbreak{}u\allowbreak{}t\allowbreak{}.\allowbreak{}l\allowbreak{}e\allowbreak{}a\allowbreak{}n} at \texttt{b435631}, 400 lines, a \texttt{module}; \texttt{namespace LeanerVM.\allowbreak{}Protocol}, \texttt{@[expose] public section}, inner \texttt{namespace PublicInput}. \par\medskip\noindent\textbf{\lean{linePoint}}\hfill\textsf{\small [load-bearing, read by Layer 12]}\par\nopagebreak

\begin{leancode}
def linePoint {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (r : E) : Vector E n := Vector.cast (by omega : 1 + (n - 1) = n) (#v[r] ++ Vector.replicate (n - 1) (0 : E))
\end{leancode}

\src{LeanerVM/Protocol/PublicInput.lean, line 65, at b435631}

The point \texttt{(\allowbreak{}r,\allowbreak{} 0,\allowbreak{} …,\allowbreak{} 0)}. \emph{Depends on:} \texttt{E}.

\par\medskip\noindent\textbf{\lean{eval₂Mle_linePoint}}\hfill\textsf{\small [load-bearing (gives \texttt{linePoint} its meaning)]}\par\nopagebreak

\begin{leancode}
theorem eval₂Mle_linePoint {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (q : CMlPolynomialEval K n) (r : E) : CMlPolynomialEval.eval₂Mle q (algebraMap K E) (linePoint hn r) = (1 - r) * ofK (q.get ⟨0, Nat.two_pow_pos n⟩) + r * ofK (q.get ⟨1, Nat.one_lt_two_pow hn.ne'⟩)
\end{leancode}

\src{LeanerVM/Protocol/PublicInput.lean, line 71, at b435631}

The extension at that point is the line through cells 0 and 1: the bit order is proved (coordinate 0 = low bit). \emph{Depends on:} CompPoly \texttt{eval₂Mle}, Layer 1's \texttt{evalMle\_\allowbreak{}append\_\allowbreak{}boolVec}, \texttt{boolVec\_\allowbreak{}zero}.

\subsection{The generic modules the phase uses}

The three generic modules (all at \texttt{b435631}; the brief's section 8 says the first and third were restated at \texttt{144c5aa} on VCVio's new probability notation):

\par\medskip\noindent\textbf{\lean{Verifier.GuardedForm.of_probEvent_pos}}\hfill\textsf{\small [load-bearing (used by three components)]}\par\nopagebreak

\begin{leancode}
theorem Verifier.GuardedForm.of_probEvent_pos {V : Verifier oSpec StmtIn StmtOut pSpec} (G : V.GuardedForm) … (h : Pr[P | OptionT.mk do (simulateQ impl (V.run stmt tr)).run' (← init)] > 0) : G.check stmt tr = true ∧ P (G.out stmt tr)
\end{leancode}

\src{LeanerVM/Protocol/ToArkLib/GuardedVerdict.lean, line 40, at b435631}

If a guarded verifier can output a statement with property \texttt{P}, its check passes and its verdict has \texttt{P}: the last obligation of a knowledge state function.

\par\medskip\noindent\textbf{\lean{Reduction.mem_support_run_of_guarded}}\hfill\textsf{\small [load-bearing]}\par\nopagebreak

\begin{leancode}
theorem Reduction.mem_support_run_of_guarded (reduction : Reduction …) (G : reduction.verifier.GuardedForm) (stmt) (wit) {y} (hy : y ∈ support (reduction.run stmt wit).run) : ∃ pr ∈ support (reduction.prover.run stmt wit), y = if G.check stmt pr.1 then some (pr, G.out stmt pr.1) else none
\end{leancode}

\src{LeanerVM/Protocol/ToArkLib/GuardedVerdict.lean, line 73, at b435631}

Every outcome of a run is a prover run plus the verdict or a rejection: completeness reduces to the prover's runs.

theorem probEvent_uniformSample_le_of_subsingleton (p : α → Prop) (h : ∀ a b, p a → p b → a = b) : Pr[p | $ᵗ α] ≤ ((1 / Fintype.card α : ℝ≥0) : ℝ≥0∞)
